use default

klarner_rado(count: int) -> Collections.List[int] is
    let sequence = LIST()
    sequence.add(1)

    let twos mut = 0
    let threes mut = 0

    while sequence.count < count do
        let from_two = 2 * sequence[twos] + 1
        let from_three = 3 * sequence[threes] + 1

        if from_two < from_three then
            sequence.add(from_two)
            twos = twos + 1
        elif from_three < from_two then
            sequence.add(from_three)
            threes = threes + 1
        else
            sequence.add(from_two)
            twos = twos + 1
            threes = threes + 1
        fi
    od

    return sequence
si

let sequence = klarner_rado(1_000_000)

write_line("first 100 elements:")

for row in 0..10 do
    let cells = LIST()

    for column in 0..10 do
        cells.add("{sequence[row * 10 + column],6}")
    od

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od

let ranks = [
    (1_000, 999), (10_000, 9_999), (100_000, 99_999), (1_000_000, 999_999)
]

for (rank, index) in ranks do
    write_line("element {rank,9}: {sequence[index]}")
od
